correctness.rationale: Direct expansion of the defining F_p gives F_p=A X^p+B Y^p+C Z^p with homogeneous cubics A=X²Y-Z³-X²Z, B=Y²Z-X³, C=XZ²+X³-Y³ and identity X A+Y B+Z C=0. At F_p-rational points, differentiating in char p gives gradient F_p=-(A,B,C); no point with any coordinate zero can solve all cubics. Y=1, X=u, B=0 implies Z=u³ and C=0 implies u^7+u^3-1=0, with A then automatic. The degree-7 h=T^7+T^3-1 has no irreducible F2 factor of degree ≤3 and hence is irreducible over Q. The explicit squarefree mod-467 factorization (five linear, one irreducible quadratic) puts a transposition in its transitive prime-degree Galois group; primitivity and normal-closure transpositions force S7. Outside finitely many ramified primes, Frobenius fixed points are the rational roots. Chebotarev and derangements yield counts (1854,1855,924,315,70,21,0,1)/5040, in particular 103/280 for zero. Finite small-field checks are corroboration only; no false geometric smoothness claim is made.
residual_risks: The rational-singular count does not characterize geometric smoothness over algebraic closure.
The Chebotarev densities ignore a finite set of ramified primes, while root/singularity bijection still holds for p>=5.

value.rationale: Asgarli–Ghioca study the natural C_(k,r) plane-filling family and the locus of rational smoothness, so fixing k=1,r=2 and varying the prime is a motivated arithmetic specialization. The exact distribution gives eight possible counts (including impossible count 6) and a positive natural density 103/280 of rationally nonsingular members. Computing the specific septic Galois group is a finite but essential structural step enabling an infinite Chebotarev classification, not merely a list of tested primes. No claim is made about geometric smoothness or a new general theorem on all curves.
residual_risks: The density is obtained by a standard theorem after one particular S7 computation; its mathematical value is the natural explicit curve-family distribution, not an advance to Chebotarev.
